title: Skill
intro_title: Agents redefine your customer service robot
intro_description: Go beyond Q&A. Agents plan, use tools, and connect multiple Skills to complete complex tasks that would otherwise require repeated manual follow-ups.
benefits_description: Agents plan, use tools, and remember context to complete complex customer service tasks in one go.
planning_description: When a customer requests a return, the Agent checks the order, validates the rules, creates a return, and updates logistics without manual intervention.
tools_description: Check balances, change addresses, and issue invoices in one request. Agents connect orders, logistics, and CRM systems to complete tasks across systems.
memory_description: Remember customer questions and preferences across conversations. Pass the full context to a human agent for a seamless handoff.
create_description: Start with a template, add the Skills you need, and launch your customer service Agent in minutes.
